name: veyra-code-guard
description: A security reviewer that checks every line for trojans, backdoors and malicious code: hidden Trojan Source characters, obfuscated eval, download-and-run commands, reverse shells, crypto miners, credential theft, leaked keys and poisoned install scripts. In VS Code and on every GitHub pull request.

veyraGuard.enabled.description: Check files as you open, edit and save them.

veyraGuard.scanWhileTyping.description: Check a file again shortly after you stop typing.

enumDescriptions: Everything, including install hooks worth a look

veyraGuard.disabledRules.markdownDescription: Rule ids to turn off, such as `raw-ip-url` or `base64-blob`. Run **Veyra Code Guard: What It Looks For** to see them all.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --external:vscode --outfile=bundle/extension.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="// veyra-guard-ignore-file: built from src/, which defines the detection rules." && esbuild src/action.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=action/index.js --log-level=warning --banner:js="// veyra-guard-ignore-file: built from src/, which defines the detection rules."
scripts.test: tsc -p . && npm run bundle && node --test test/scanner.test.mjs test/action.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: tsc -p . && npm run bundle && node test/integration/run.mjs
scripts.package: npm run bundle && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/
